content: Jesu busuwadok nai dulalune kudi mebimebi mintaneeŋ
Jesu adi Siloŋyot gineniŋ fooŋ buŋa uune mihiŋiyedi wooŋ Siloŋyot makudikudile tigiŋ u nimbune yabuguk. U yabuŋa mede toboniŋ indiŋ tubu-udaneyemguk,
“Nu biyagoŋ hinek hanilat, nemenemek i yabuŋa yoiŋ yoŋ, memik hekidi Siloŋyot ubulagineeŋ youpupuhene-kudapmaune molomolom mapupuheneeŋ ila uneeŋ.”

Unduŋ yeniŋa looŋ Oliwa Tuwai foloŋ ilune mihiŋiye nehi hogok buŋa indiŋ ninadigiŋ, “Nemek yoŋaŋ u nai deniŋ hinek mintawaak? Tiŋa undugoŋ da busuwabusuwage nai dulalune be kwet i liwedok nai dulalune kudi dediŋ mintawaak?”
Unduŋ yobune Jesudi indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Tikamanda tihamuŋa nadinadihik tubugiyondaneeneŋ ala nadinadiŋila hatiyaneeŋ.
Metam feedi buŋa nu wotnene foloŋ yokamanda indiŋ tineeŋ, ‘Kilisto na iŋakoŋ.’ Unduŋ yoŋa metam fee yehitubu-giyondaneeŋ.

Hidi mik wapum mintaune gigilitŋiŋ nadineeŋ, be mik kwet niŋkade gwaŋ mintawe tubune gigitŋiŋ hogok nadiŋa munta tiŋa heheleeŋ nadibediŋa nai agaŋ dulalak mu yoneeŋ. Nemenemek undihi mintaneeŋ iŋgoŋ nai wapum adi pilap mu mintawaak.
Kwetkwet metam bop wapum be bop kuyaniŋ adi nehi uŋgoŋ kibikibi mindobuneeŋ. Kaŋ yokwet noli gineŋ map wapum mintawaak, eŋ kwetkwet kenim titawaak.
Nemek hogohogok u mintawaak, kaŋ nai wapum diniŋ folofigita adi nai uŋaniŋ tububihila tamwoidi wapmihi yanagitne nadiiŋ undiniŋ mintawaak.”
Nai wapum dulaune malabumuŋ fee mintawaak
“Kaŋ nai uŋaniŋ hidi hanagila folofigita hamuŋa fidihikumuneeŋ. Tiŋa kwetkwet nutok tiŋa habukwihitaneeŋ.
Tiŋa nai uŋaniŋ metam feedi nadisukilitihik gweheyeune nohiye yabukwihitaaŋ bolik tiyemiŋa memik heki kohohik foloŋ yapmeneeŋ.
Tiŋa undugoŋ polofet yalayalaŋdi buŋa metam nadisuhik tubugiyondaneeŋ.
Kaŋ kadakaniŋdi ulihakaune metam feedi welekubugoŋ hatihati bikabuneeŋ.
“Iŋgoŋ nebek niŋ adi fafaŋe tiŋa hatibaak adi Bepaŋdi tubulodaune Hatihati Kobuli kahilewaak.
Kaŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ diniŋ gigitŋiŋ yohautaune kwetkwet udapmaune metam hogohogok nadidapmaneeŋ, kaŋ nai uŋaniŋ dapmandapmaŋ nai mintawaak.”
Nemek kadakaniŋ hinek mintawaak
“Polofet Daniyeldi mede yoguk u gitagoŋ hinek ila kunatnadiyaneeŋ. Medeŋiŋ wendi fafaŋewaak kaŋ nemek kadakaniŋ hinehinek wendi Siloŋyotneŋ yalune kaneeŋ.
U mintaune kaŋ me Judiya kwetneŋ hatineeŋ heki hidi momoŋ tuwai foloŋ loneeŋ.
Be me niŋ yot foloniŋ halaak adi kotigoŋ yot maaneŋ bomboŋŋiŋ kaliŋ mu fowaak.
Be me niŋ kade gineŋ hatibaak adi yopmande tinahukutŋiŋ kaliŋ mu waak.
Hidige! Nai uŋaniŋ, tam mihiwelehinit eŋ tam eyaŋhinit adi kada, dediŋ tineeŋ.
Hidi nemek undiniŋ gwi nai foloŋ be Sabat nai foloŋ mu mintahamdok nadikaaŋ Bepaŋ ninadineeŋ.
Koom kwet tububihit tiŋa mintagukneŋ nemek malabumuŋ mintagiŋ iŋgoŋ yendi yalakapmeŋ tiŋa mintaune mindaŋ kotigoŋ undiniŋ nemu mintawaak.

“Nemek malabumuŋ u nai kweheyeniŋgoŋ mintadok iŋgoŋ oŋ, Wapumdi metamŋiye koom netok gigit yehidaneguk aditok nadiŋa nai-kabe ulatifowaak. Nai mu ulatifowe tuguk binek wa nebek nemu uluwek, kumuŋdapmaŋ taneŋ.”
Mede yotubufit me fee mintaneeŋ
“Nai uŋaniŋ nebek niŋdi ‘Kilisto iŋoŋ hatak,’ be ‘Kilisto gwaŋ hatak,’ hanimbune medeŋiŋ mu nadimineeŋ hinek.

Nai uŋaniŋ Kilisto yalayalaŋ eŋ polofet yalayalaŋ fee mintaaŋ kudi wapuhi saŋiniŋnit tiŋa metam nadinadihik tubugiyondaneeŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa Bepaŋdi metam netok gigit yoŋa yabukahileguk u nadisuhik tubugiyondadok kwanai tineeŋ, iŋgoŋ adi nadisuhik tubugiyondadok saŋiniŋ mu hatak doktiŋa kwanaimiŋ tineeŋ.
Nu agaŋ timeŋgoŋ hanimbihitat doktiŋa hatigene mintaune kaŋ nadigiyonda mu tineeŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa metamdi Jesu kwet fiileŋ gwaŋ kayam hanimbune kaŋ uŋoŋ mu waneeŋ, be yotmaaŋ gwendok kamun yobune kaŋ u maaŋ medehik mu nadiyaneeŋ.
Hidi filimpit tilak u agaŋ kaŋ nadiiŋ. Adi mele labulabuneŋkade tububihilune hautaŋiŋdi wooŋ mele fofoŋneŋkade dapmalak. Wendok tuwolit hinek Me Kobumuŋ busuwa-busuwa naiŋiŋ foloŋ mintawaak.
Dabaŋ daŋ hali bitakaiŋ uŋoŋ kalaŋkatak hekidi bopneiŋ.”
Jesu buswawaak diniŋ mede

“Nemenemek malabumuŋ hogohogok u mintadapmawaak, kaŋ uŋaniŋ meledibo mambip tibaak eŋ muyakip maaŋ hauta mu tibaak, kaŋ bamholiŋa heki kunum gineniŋ kwehik biŋa diliteleeŋ maneeŋ. Kaŋ kunum mahamulune nemenemek hogohogok waliwali tiŋa igiyonda tineeŋ.

Unduŋ tulune Me Kobumuŋ’walaŋ kudi kunum foloŋ mintawaak, kaŋ kwetkwet metam hogohogok adi u kaŋ makat kobulabulaye tulune Me Kobumuŋ adi kunum mulukwaŋ foloŋ hauta holiholiŋe tiŋa saŋiniŋ wapumnit busuwaune kaneeŋ.
Tiŋa aŋeloŋiye yeniŋkulune bai gigilitnit kwet tububihila hali wooŋ daŋ hadapmalak wendok tuwot tuŋtuŋ fodapmaaŋ metamŋiye yabukahileeŋ yehidaneguk hogohogok u yehibopneneeŋ.”
Nai diniŋ mede
“Bem fik u kaŋ nadineŋ, hapmuŋ madapmaune hapmuŋ gitipmuŋ duhulak kaŋ meleyaŋ nai yoyam.
Undugoŋ hinek nemek u mintaune kaŋ agaŋ nihitubu-dulaaŋ yeme foloŋ yatak nadineeŋ.
Biyagoŋ hinek hanilat. Metam kumuŋdapmaŋ mu tulune nemenemek i mintawaak.
Kunum kwet adi liwedemeek iŋgoŋ nu’walaŋ medene adi tuwot mu liwewaak.

“Tiŋa nebek niŋdi helebufa nai be melenai deniŋ hinek nemek i mintawaak u mu nadilak. Aŋelo heki kunum gineŋ hatiiŋ adi maaŋ mu nadiiŋ. Eŋ Bepaŋ mihiŋiŋdi maaŋ undugoŋ mu nadilak. Bepaŋ ne hogok nadilak.
Nowa’walaŋ nai foloŋ metamdi nemek tigiŋ, undugoŋ hinek Me Kobumuŋ busuwadok naiŋiŋ dulalune mintawaak.
Adi ime gabuŋ be ime bedi mu tulune kale nanaŋe nanadifo tigiŋ. Tam kibikibi tiŋa hekimalam tigiŋ.
Adi nai mu nadiŋa unduŋ hati tulune Nowa muwage gineŋ loguk. Kaŋ nai uŋaniŋ ime gabuŋ wapum tiŋa ime dombuŋgolooŋ metam yehikufulaguk. Me Kobumuŋ busuwawaakneŋ undugoŋ hinek mintawaak.
Me lufom dinina gineŋ hatilune me kubugoŋ hogok nagila noli bikabudok.
Eŋ tamyat lufom adi henaŋ noŋgoŋ ila tulune kubugoŋ hogok nagila niŋ bikabudok.
Wapumhikdi nai deniŋ hinek baak u hidi mu nadiiŋ doktiŋa nadinadiŋila woom tiŋa hatiyaneeŋ.

“Tiŋa indiŋ maaŋ nadineŋ. Me niŋ adi kubome hekidi yoli ubulaginedok nai agaŋ binek nadilakneŋ damo tuwot mu deiletiŋak. Hogok damo kaipmuŋ halune me kubome hekidi yoli tuwot mu ubulagineeŋ fonetiŋit.
Wendok tuwot, hidi maaŋ undugoŋ welehik tiulidokooŋ hatiyaneeŋ. Me Kobumuŋ adi naininde hidi mu nadiŋa hogok hatifit tulune tobogoŋ busuwawaak. Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi tiulidokoŋila hatiyaneeŋ.”
Nadibubuye mu tiŋa hatidok
“Me nadinadinit, me momooŋ adi bomboŋgidi me talitimeŋ kameune tipilapilaye-me noli nanaŋehik nai foloŋgoŋ daneyemuluwaak.
Unduŋ ti hatulune bomboŋgidi busuwaaŋ kaŋ aditok nadifo tibaak.
Nu biyagoŋ hinek hanilat. Adi talitimeŋ loloŋnit kameeŋ nemenemekŋiŋ noli maaŋ yabudokodok nindapmawaak.
“Be me u kadokome hogoli hatiŋa indiŋ yobek: ‘Me bomboŋgine adi pilap mu baak ale.’
Unduŋ yoŋa tipilapilaye-metam noli widihiŋa nanaŋe naaŋ ime fafaŋeŋ maaŋ naaŋ tibubuye hatibaak.
Unduŋ tiŋa me bomboŋgiŋiŋ tiyaugene bek u nadinadinit mokit hogok bubuyeŋgoŋ hatilune
bomboŋgi busuwawaak. Busuwaaŋ talitimeŋ u utubufigitaaŋ kisaŋ wihitnadiŋa tukulune fooŋ yalaŋ-me heki dut hali kobulabulayeeŋ maŋiŋ sikilitiŋa masiŋkilip ha-tobaak.”
